hero.eyebrow: A gym pilot, built around trainers
hero.h1: Make every workout easier to understand.
hero.body: Plan your training, log your sets and see your progress. Review the bigger picture with a trainer you choose.
hero.microcopy: Android pilot · Web Studio · English & Dutch
hero.translationNote: App translations are still being refined.
hero.figureAlt: Illustrative SculptaLab training overview on a phone

trainers.h2: A better conversation at the gym.
trainers.body: Your client brings the training history. You bring the coaching. Review shared workouts and progress together, with access controlled by the client.
trainers.caption: Pilot workflow; public onboarding is being prepared.
trainers.figureAlt: Illustrative trainer and client discussing training on a tablet

planTrain.h2: A plan you can actually follow.
planTrain.row1: Start with a plan that fits your routine.
planTrain.row2: Keep sets, reps and weights in one place.
planTrain.row3: Finish your session and see what you did.
planTrain.supporting: Strength sessions, cardio logs and a calendar that keeps the week clear.
planTrain.workoutNote: Set logging and rest timers only — live camera scoring is off in the default pilot.
planTrain.planAlt: Weekly training plan on a phone
planTrain.workoutAlt: Workout player with sets and rest timer

muscles.body: Explore training volume and progression by muscle group. Switch between anatomy views and compare periods in Studio.
muscles.disclaimer: Training-based estimates, not a body scan or medical assessment.
muscles.figureAlt: Illustrative training muscle map, not a body scan

progressStudio.body: Follow estimated strength, personal records and training patterns. Move from a summary into the sessions behind it.
progressStudio.col1Body: Estimated strength, e1RM and personal records from your logged work.
progressStudio.col2Body: Volume trends, load, RIR and consistency against your own history.
progressStudio.col3Body: Weekly summaries, adherence and computed insights from real sessions.
progressStudio.figureAlt: Studio dashboard overview with scores and sessions

form.h2: Look back at how you moved.
form.body: Explore form feedback for supported movements in the pilot. Availability depends on the enabled analysis features.
form.footnote: Not a substitute for a trainer or medical advice.
form.cta: What is available in the pilot?

learnDaily.body: Learn the movement, remember the session and keep your training together.

roadmap.h2: In the pilot. Next on the roadmap.
roadmap.pilotList: Plans, logging, Studio dashboards, consent-based trainer sharing, Muscle Intelligence and core Android workflow.
roadmap.plannedList: Public store rollout, trainer invites, expanded form tools, trainer-authored plans, watch and gym integrations.

faq.a1: Android access is arranged for pilot participants. Public store links are not live yet.
faq.a2: An iOS release is not confirmed for this pilot.
faq.a3: Trainer access follows the sharing permissions you grant. Review scope and expiry in the app.
faq.q4: Does the body show actual muscle growth?
faq.a4: No. It visualises training-derived metrics and estimates.
faq.q5: Can I use it in Dutch?
faq.a5: The site is bilingual. Dutch app translations are still being refined.
faq.a6: Pilot arrangements are confirmed during the demo; there is no public pricing checkout here.

pilotFooter.h2: Bring it to your next trainer conversation.
pilotFooter.body: Start with a guided demo before inviting clients.
pilotFooter.demoExplanation: A guided demo walks through Android setup, consent scopes and a first training session on the gym floor.

trainers.h1: Coach the person, with their training in view.
trainers.intro: Trainer tools for consent-based review during the gym pilot.
trainers.figureAlt: Trainer view of consent-scoped client training data
trainers.syntheticNote: Mock client names in screenshots are invented and labelled.

s1.h2: Start with a guided gym pilot
s1.body: The pilot is designed for trainer-led introductions on the gym floor, not self-serve public rollout.

s2.body: Trainer Web routes cover sign-in, onboarding and home views for reviewing granted client access.

s3.body: Clients choose scopes, expiry and revocation. Trainers only see data within an active grant.

s4.body: Open shared workouts, progress summaries and Studio views to prepare the next conversation.

s5.body: Preview how submitted form checks appear in the trainer queue when analysis features are enabled.

s6.body: Group session routes exist for trainer and member previews; class orchestration is not assumed shipped.

s7.item1: Trainer-originated client invites without a client grant
s7.item2: Public store downloads and universal AI form release
s7.item3: Published pricing or checkout on this marketing site

s8.check1: Confirm Android pilot build and Studio access for the demo device
s8.check2: Walk through consent scopes and revocation with the client
s8.check3: Review one real or demo session together on the gym floor

features.intro: Honest status for every implemented area in the pilot codebase.
features.note: Statuses describe implementation evidence in the pilot, not global production availability.
features.legend: Platform badges follow the manifest; caveats stay beside every row.

pilot.intro: Trainer-led demo → supervised Android setup → consent discussion → first session → feedback.
pilot.step1: Trainer conversation about goals and how sharing will work
pilot.step2: Supervised Android install or sideload for the pilot build
pilot.step3: Consent scopes, expiry and what the trainer can see
pilot.step4: First logged session with plan, sets and optional Studio follow-up
pilot.step5: Feedback call — what worked, what stays off until the next milestone
pilot.availabilityHeading: What is enabled in the pilot
pilot.availabilityBody: Default pilot flags keep live camera, form scoring and premium features off unless enabled for your supervised demo.
pilot.limitsHeading: Practical limits still under launch review
pilot.limit1: Public HTTPS app origin and backup/restore need verification for your deployment
pilot.limit2: Privacy, terms and health consent copy must be owner-approved before real health data
pilot.limit3: Trainer invite flow and error monitoring remain pilot prerequisites
pilot.limit4: Dutch app copy is improving; native review is not finished
pilot.limit5: Store listings and iOS availability are not established for this pilot
pilot.noFormNote: This static site does not collect health data or submit demo registrations.
pilot.figureAlt: Trainer preparing a phone for a gym-floor demo

onboarding-plan.title: Getting started: account & plan
onboarding-plan.description: Sign in, set preferences and build a training plan that fits your routine.
onboarding-plan.caveat: Pilot flow; no fixed question-count promise.

workout-player.title: Train: sessions & workout player
workout-player.description: See upcoming sessions, log sets with load and rest, swap exercises and finish workouts.
workout-player.caveat: Pilot core workflow; no live camera scoring in the default pilot.

activity-logging.title: Activity: strength, cardio & calendar
activity-logging.description: Log strength sets and cardio, schedule sessions and browse history with source provenance.
activity-logging.caveat: Only connected sources that exist in your account are shown.

progress-scores.title: Progress: scores, records & consistency
progress-scores.description: Estimated strength, personal records, volume, load, RIR and consistency compared with your own history.
progress-scores.caveat: No population fitness tiers; incomplete metrics are labelled.

muscle-intelligence.title: Muscle Intelligence
muscle-intelligence.description: Training volume and progression by muscle group with front/back anatomy views in Studio.
muscle-intelligence.caveat: Training-derived estimates, not a body scan.

exercise-learn.title: Exercise library & learning
exercise-learn.description: Search exercises, cues, movement demonstrations and science notes.
exercise-learn.caveat: Catalogue size follows the app, not a marketing count.

form-analysis-preview.title: Form analysis preview
form-analysis-preview.description: Recorded movement feedback for supported exercises when analysis features are enabled.
form-analysis-preview.caveat: Preview / pilot-gated; limited movements; no universal AI claim.

daily-timers-bubble.title: Reminders & floating workout bubble
daily-timers-bubble.description: Rest timers, reminders and resume helpers; floating bubble on supported Android builds.

health-connections.title: Health & activity connections
health-connections.description: Import and sync from connected accounts with duplicate handling and source labels.
health-connections.caveat: Health Connect, HealthKit and Strava must be confirmed individually; not every watch.

studio-dashboard.title: Studio dashboard
studio-dashboard.description: Personal overview and configurable views in Web Studio.
studio-dashboard.caveat: Customization only if enabled in your pilot.

studio-blocks-insights.title: Blocks, reports & insights
studio-blocks-insights.description: Compare blocks, adherence summaries and computed session insights.
studio-blocks-insights.caveat: No causal AI assertions or guaranteed forecasts.

studio-body.title: Body check-ins
studio-body.description: Bodyweight trends when you log check-ins.
studio-body.caveat: Neutral language; no invented body composition.

nutrition-education.title: Nutrition education
nutrition-education.description: Protein and nutrition tips in the app; Studio diet views where enabled.
nutrition-education.caveat: Not a shipped trainer-authored meal prescription.

trainer-consent-sharing.title: Consent-based trainer sharing
trainer-consent-sharing.description: Clients choose scopes; trainers review grants with expiry and instant revocation.

trainer-queue.title: Trainer form queue
trainer-queue.description: Preview workflow for reviewing client form submissions.

group-sessions-preview.title: Group sessions preview
group-sessions-preview.description: Trainer and member group workspace routes in preview.
group-sessions-preview.caveat: Watch following, alerts and class orchestration not assumed shipped.

account-billing-settings.title: Account, billing & settings
account-billing-settings.description: Units, theme, profile and account controls; billing gated in pilot.
account-billing-settings.caveat: No public pricing or checkout on this site.

additional-legacy-views.title: Additional views
additional-legacy-views.description: Shareable presentation modes and legacy or experimental screens.
additional-legacy-views.caveat: Audit before screenshots; not core product promises.

studio-lab-research.title: Studio lab research previews
studio-lab-research.description: Hidden experimental panels: forecasts, PR prediction, clustering and related research tools.
studio-lab-research.caveat: Research previews, not available user capabilities.

planned-roadmap.title: Roadmap: stores, watch & integrations
planned-roadmap.description: Wear OS, Apple Watch, Live Activities, gym QR, trainer plan editing and public store rollout.
planned-roadmap.caveat: Planned; no dates or availability claims.

bilingual-nl-en.title: Dutch & English
bilingual-nl-en.description: Localized app and marketing site; native Dutch review ongoing.
bilingual-nl-en.caveat: Site is bilingual; app NL copy still being refined.
